title.zh: 供應鏈韌性與地緣政治風險戰略 (CSCO / COO 視角)
title.en: Supply Chain Resilience & Geopolitical Risk Strategy (CSCO/COO Perspective)

slide_title.zh: 地緣政治斷鏈危機與戰略訴求 (SCQA & The Ask)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：我們目前的全球供應鏈高度集中於單一高風險地區，過去享受了極致的規模經濟與低廉製造成本
衝突 (Complication)：隨著大國貿易戰、關稅壁壘與出口管制升級，這種「單點故障 (Single-Point-of-Failure)」的結構隨時會導致全線斷鏈與違約
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：提議將供應鏈戰略從「成本極佳化」轉向「營運韌性」，懇請董事會核准 [X 億] 資本支出以啟動「中國加一 (China Plus One)」與供應鏈數位化計畫
en: Situation: Our global supply chain is hyper-concentrated in a single high-risk geopolitical zone, historically yielding maximum economies of scale and cost efficiency.
Complication: Escalating trade wars, tariff barriers, and export controls have turned this structure into a catastrophic 'Single-Point-of-Failure,' threatening imminent fulfillment defaults.

The Ask: Proposing a strategic pivot from 'Cost-Optimization' to 'Operational Resilience.' Requesting Board approval for a [$X] CapEx injection to execute a 'China Plus One' transition and supply chain digitization.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，過去十年我們靠著極致的供應鏈集中化賺取了豐厚利潤，但那個時代已經結束了。現在的地緣政治摩擦，讓我們的單一產地變成了一顆定時炸彈。只要一道新的關稅或出口禁令，我們的產線就會瞬間停擺。今天的提案，是要幫公司買一份最關鍵的『營運保險』，把我們的供應鏈從脆弱變得具備強大韌性。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, the era of hyper-concentrated, cost-optimized supply chains is over. Current geopolitical friction has turned our single-source manufacturing hub into a ticking time bomb. A single new tariff or export ban could paralyze our fulfillment instantly. Today's proposal is about purchasing the ultimate 'operational insurance'—transforming our supply chain from fragile to aggressively resilient.

slide_title.zh: 典範轉移：從 JIT 到 JIC (Paradigm Shift: JIT to JIC)
slide_title.en: The Paradigm Shift: From JIT to JIC

zh: 及時生產 (Just-In-Time) 的終結：放棄過去為了追求「零庫存」而犧牲容錯率的極端模式，承認斷鏈已是新常態
戰略緩衝 (Just-In-Case, JIC)：針對前 20% 貢獻 80% 營收的核心關鍵零組件，強制建立 [X] 天的安全庫存 (Safety Stock) 作為戰略緩衝
營運資金平衡 (Working Capital Impact)：向 CFO 與董事會承諾，增加的庫存持有成本 (Holding Cost) 將被斷鏈時挽救的營收與違約金完全抵銷
en: The End of Just-In-Time (JIT): Abandoning the extreme 'zero-inventory' models that sacrificed margin-of-error, accepting supply shocks as the new normal.
Strategic Buffers (Just-In-Case - JIC): Mandating a [X]-day Safety Stock buffer exclusively for the critical top 20% of components that drive 80% of our revenue.
Working Capital Balance: Assuring the CFO and Board that the increased inventory holding costs are mathematically dwarfed by the revenue protected from stock-outs and breach-of-contract penalties.

speaker_notes.zh: 商學院過去教我們『及時生產 (JIT)』是王道，但在極端風險下，JIT 就是自殺。我們必須轉向『戰略預備 (Just-In-Case)』。這不代表我們要盲目囤貨，而是精準針對最核心的關鍵零組件建立安全庫存。我知道 CFO 會擔心營運資金 (Working Capital) 被卡住，但請相信，這點庫存成本，絕對比交不出貨被客戶告違約要便宜得多。
speaker_notes.en: Business schools taught us 'Just-In-Time (JIT)' was the gold standard; in today's risk landscape, JIT is corporate suicide. We must pivot to 'Just-In-Case (JIC).' This isn't blind hoarding; it is surgical buffer-building for mission-critical components. I acknowledge the CFO's concern regarding Working Capital lock-up, but mathematically, this holding cost is exponentially cheaper than the catastrophic penalties of fulfillment defaults.

slide_title.zh: 近岸外包與供應商多元化 (Nearshoring & Diversification)

zh: 中國加一戰略 (China Plus One)：保留原產地供應當地市場，同時將 [X]% 的出口產能戰略性轉移至東南亞 (ASEAN) 或印度
近岸/友岸外包 (Nearshoring/Friendshoring)：針對北美核心市場，於墨西哥啟動次級組裝廠，大幅縮短交期 (Lead Time) 並規避海運塞港風險
雙源採購機制 (Dual-Sourcing)：嚴格禁止單一供應商獨家供貨 (Sole Source)，強制要求所有關鍵料件具備至少兩家具備量產能力的合格供應商
en: China Plus One Strategy: Retaining incumbent capacity for local consumption while strategically migrating [X]% of export manufacturing to ASEAN or India.
Nearshoring & Friendshoring: Launching secondary assembly hubs in Mexico to service the core North American market, slashing lead times and bypassing ocean freight bottlenecks.
Dual-Sourcing Mandate: Strictly prohibiting 'Sole Source' dependencies; mandating that all critical BOM components have at least two fully qualified and scalable suppliers.

speaker_notes.zh: 要降低地緣政治風險，我們必須重新畫一張全球產能地圖。我們將啟動『China Plus One』，並導入『近岸外包』，把產線拉到離終端市場更近的地方，例如東南亞或墨西哥。同時，採購部門的 KPI 將全面改寫：『單一來源 (Sole Source)』將被視為最高級別的內部違規，所有關鍵料件都必須有備胎 (Dual-Sourcing)。
speaker_notes.en: To neutralize geopolitical risks, we must redraw our global manufacturing footprint. We are executing 'China Plus One' and 'Nearshoring'—moving production closer to end-markets like ASEAN and Mexico. Concurrently, Procurement KPIs are being aggressively rewritten: 'Sole Sourcing' is now classified as a Tier-1 internal compliance violation. Every critical component must possess a qualified, scalable backup.

slide_title.zh: 供應鏈數位孿生與控制塔 (Digital Twin & AI Control Tower)
slide_title.en: Digital Twin & AI Supply Chain Control Tower

zh: 數位孿生 (Digital Twin)：建構端到端的供應鏈數位模型，涵蓋從原物料 (Tier 3) 到終端客戶的完整節點
AI 控制塔 (AI Control Tower)：整合外部數據（如氣象、港口罷工、地緣政治新聞），透過機器學習進行斷鏈風險的預測性警示
情境兵推 (Scenario Planning)：利用系統模擬「若某港口封鎖 14 天」對我們營收的衝擊，並自動生成產能轉移的最佳解 (Optimization)
en: Digital Twin: Architecting an end-to-end digital replica of our entire supply chain, mapping nodes from raw material extraction (Tier 3) to final-mile delivery.
AI Control Tower: Ingesting exogenous data (e.g., weather, port strikes, geopolitical news feeds) via Machine Learning to generate predictive disruption alerts.
Scenario Planning (War-gaming): Leveraging the system to simulate shocks—such as a 14-day port blockade—and autonomously calculating the optimal capacity rerouting protocols.

speaker_notes.zh: 在複雜的全球供應鏈中，『看不見』才是最大的恐懼。我們正在建置『AI 供應鏈控制塔』與『數位孿生』。這代表未來當某個國家發生罷工或地震時，我們不需要等供應商打電話來求救，我們的 AI 系統在幾分鐘內就能發出警報，甚至自動幫我們計算出如何把訂單轉移到其他國家的工廠。這就是用科技打造的絕對韌性。
speaker_notes.en: In complex global supply chains, 'blind spots' are the ultimate terror. We are deploying an 'AI Control Tower' and a 'Digital Twin.' This means when a port strike or earthquake hits a region, we don't wait for panicked supplier emails. Our AI triggers an alert within minutes and autonomously calculates the mathematical optimum for rerouting orders globally. This is absolute, technology-driven resilience.

slide_title.zh: 180 天產能轉移藍圖 (180-Day Relocation & Action Plan)

zh: 首 60 天 (Audit & Sourcing)：完成二階/三階供應商 (Tier 2/3) 的地緣政治曝險盤點，並於新目標國家選定 3 家候選代工廠
60-120 天 (Qualification & NPI)：派遣工程與品保 (QA) 團隊進駐，完成新產線的產品驗證 (Qualification) 與首件檢查 (FAI)
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請董事會核准 [X 萬] 的供應鏈重構資本支出，並授權 CSCO 簽署跨國產能轉移的長約 (Long-term Agreement)
en: First 60 Days (Audit & Sourcing): Complete full geopolitical exposure audits on Tier 2/3 suppliers, and down-select 3 candidate contract manufacturers in the new target region.
Days 60-120 (Qualification & NPI): Deploying Engineering and QA tiger teams on-site to execute rigorous product qualification and First Article Inspections (FAI).
Call to Action: Requesting Board approval for the [$X] Supply Chain Restructuring CapEx, and empowering the CSCO to execute binding Long-Term Agreements (LTAs) for the new capacity.

speaker_notes.zh: 轉移供應鏈不是搬家，它需要極度嚴謹的工程驗證。這是我們的 180 天行動藍圖。前兩個月我們進行尋商與曝險盤點；接著工程團隊會進駐海外進行打樣與品質驗證。為了確保我們在新產地能搶到最好的產能，懇請董事會核准這筆資本支出，並授權我們與新供應商簽下長約，鎖定未來的營運命脈。
speaker_notes.en: Relocating a supply chain is not a simple move; it requires ruthless engineering validation. Here is our 180-day roadmap. The first two months are dedicated to sourcing and exposure audits. Then, engineering tiger teams deploy overseas for sampling and QA validation. To ensure we secure tier-1 capacity in these new regions, I request Board CapEx approval and the mandate to lock in our operational lifeline via Long-Term Agreements.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『供應鏈韌性與地緣政治風險戰略』簡報。受眾為董事會、CEO 或風險管理委員會。內容必須展現 CSCO (首席供應鏈官) 兼具總體經濟與廠區營運的戰略視野：1. 運用 SCQA 點出單一產地帶來的斷鏈危機與地緣政治風險，2. 闡述從 JIT (及時生產) 轉向 JIC (戰略預備) 的典範轉移，並向 CFO 證明其營運資金的合理性，3. 提出 China Plus One 與近岸外包 (Nearshoring) 戰略，嚴禁單一來源採購，4. 導入數位孿生與 AI 供應鏈控制塔，強調預測性兵推能力，5. 結尾給出 180 天產能轉移藍圖 (尋商、打樣、驗證)，並爭取資本支出與長約授權。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需充滿危機意識、佈局全球的魄力與極強的執行紀律。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Supply Chain Resilience & Geopolitical Risk Strategy' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors, CEO, or Risk Committee. Demonstrate the CSCO's elite strategic vision blending macroeconomic foresight with factory-floor execution: 1. Use SCQA to frame the existential threat of single-point-of-failure geopolitical disruptions. 2. Articulate the paradigm shift from JIT to JIC (Just-In-Case), justifying the working capital impact to the CFO. 3. Architect the 'China Plus One' and Nearshoring strategy, mandating dual-sourcing across the BOM. 4. Introduce Digital Twins and AI Control Towers to highlight predictive war-gaming capabilities. 5. Conclude with a 180-Day Relocation Roadmap (Sourcing, FAI, Qualification) and demand CapEx and Long-Term Agreement (LTA) authority. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project intense risk awareness, global operational dominance, and ruthless execution discipline.
